purpose: Original production assets for Alleylight Escort; not images of any classic game
guardian: Production game art, ORIGINAL hand-painted gouache character sprite sheet with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Exactly SIX full-body drawings of the SAME young adult female lantern-street guardian in a strict 3 columns x 2 rows equal-cell layout. Each figure separate, all facing RIGHT, boots aligned near bottom of each cell, generous empty transparent margins. Richly rendered anatomy, fabric folds, ink edge work and painted highlights, 5.5-head proportions, NOT chibi or geometric. Jade-green split long jacket, ochre-gold trailing scarf, black hair tied in a short bun, brown waist satchel, wrapped fingerless gloves, navy trousers, worn leather boots. Row1: alert guard with fists raised; walking right left leg forward; walking right right leg forward. Row2: coiled punch windup with knees bent; strong forward punch with extended fist and wide stance; low lunging dodge with scarf trailing. Same identity and costume in every cell. Premium independent game animation asset, warm gold rim light and cool indigo shadow. No words, no labels, no grid lines, no scene, no floor shadow, no weapons, no gore, no commercial character references. FULL characters with heads and feet visible in all six cells.
scenery: ORIGINAL production background atlas for a painterly 2D lantern-town side-scrolling game, beautifully detailed gouache and ink with cinematic warm amber lamps and cool indigo shadows. ONE image in a strict 2x2 equal-panel grid, no margins or borders. TOP LEFT: dawn marketplace with weathered ochre plaster, blue-grey tiled roofs, wood lattice shopfronts, fabric awnings, baskets, plants and misty roofs beyond. TOP RIGHT: rainy narrow workshop street, indigo awnings, wet brick walls, dripping gutters, stacked crates, umbrellas and soft cool fog. BOTTOM LEFT: deep blue night lantern lane beside a canal, low stone balustrade and distant arched bridge, warm lantern reflections on water. BOTTOM RIGHT: quiet night courtyard street with a tall gate, willow branches, hanging paper lanterns and moonlit roof silhouettes. Every panel side-on belt-scroller stage camera, slight view down onto a BROAD EMPTY HORIZONTAL flagstone street across the bottom45 percent; architecture along the back upper half, road travels left to right not away into central perspective. Convincing texture of worn wood, stone cracks, wet reflections and handmade cloth; lovingly painted indie-game art, cohesive palette, clear foreground/middle/distance depth. No characters, no cart, no words or signs, no labels, no UI, no logos, no commercial game references. Full bleed each quadrant, suitable to crop each of four equal regions directly into game.
rivals: ORIGINAL hand-painted gouache production sprites for a lantern-town belt action game. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, exactly 8 full-body figures in a strict 2 columns x 4 rows equal-cell grid. Each row is one unique character, same identity in both columns. Column1 guarded idle, column2 a forceful unarmed forward punch with wide planted stance. Everyone faces RIGHT, boots aligned near cell bottoms, generous transparent margin, complete head to feet, no overlaps. ROW1 lean adult man in a rust-red short jacket and charcoal loose trousers, simple cloth cap, wrapped fists, expressive lined face. ROW2 agile adult woman with tied auburn hair, indigo sleeveless vest and flowing ivory scarf, blue trousers and leather bracers. ROW3 broad heavyset middle-aged worker, maroon padded vest over grey sleeves, wide woven belt, wrapped forearms and heavy boots; visibly wider silhouette. ROW4 tall stern elder in long navy coat with silver clasps and short asymmetric cape, silver tied hair, cream inner tunic and dark boots. Richly painted fabric folds, ink contours, subtle worn material detail and warm gold rim lighting / cool indigo shadows. Human proportions 5.5heads tall, not chibi, not basic geometric. Cohesive high-quality 2D indie game animation art. No scene, no solid colored background, no floor or shadows, no weapons, no gore, no words, no labels, no grid lines, no commercial characters. Alpha transparency around every separated figure.
